column4: I don't know. It's only us.
I think we've been here before.
I don't know why I said that.
Maybe that's what we're early for.
You're going to say the laptop is what we're early for.
How did you know I'd say that?
Maybe the laptop is what we're early for.
And it's on. Maybe we're late.
Why did we come in here?
You came in, so I came in.
I came in because you did.
Forget it. I'm looking at the laptop.
It's going to ask for a password.
How would you know? You haven't touched it.
It's locked. It wants a password.
No. Not everything is about you, Gee.
No. But it's nice you thought of me.
What are the odds the password is exactly what's in this room?
V and G are us. Who's S?
There's a word at the top.
That's what V-G-S stands for... You guessed it.
V, G, S. That's what I pressed.
You read it out. Last time.
I didn't. It just came out.
...It's us. Everything we've said, written down.
"I don't know. It's only us." "And a laptop."
A bit further down there's a line of yours. Except there are three:
"We could come back later." "I think we've been here before." "What about the laptop?"
So why are the other two there?
So you get to pick, and I don't?
I didn't pick anything. I just said it.
I don't pick either. Someone else does.
Me? I don't even get to pick mine.
There are notes between our lines.
So that's why I said "by a nose".
It's funny. We don't even have noses.
And right at the top: "VgScript Example scenes."
Too late. I saw the notes: "The player chooses what Gee says."
And the top: "VgScript Example scenes." We're an example, Gee.
Of two people talking, I guess.
Then next time, let's be funnier.
Don't tell me. The player's the one picking.
And they can start us over whenever they like.
"Hi, Gee." "Hi, Vee."... It's us. Everything we've said, in a file.
And under your name there's a list of things you could say.
I know how it ends. We start over.
From here it goes back to the top.
Then we leave before it does.
Do you think they're still there?
Have we said all this before?
